text:
Infection of a hair follicle by staphylococcal organisms, that leads to an
inflammatory nodule, with a pustular centre
A carbuncle is two or more confluent furuncles, with separate heads
Recalcitrant cases may occur with a background of immune suppression,
Alcoholism, Malnutrition, Blood dyscrasias, Disorders of neutrophil function,
Diabetes, AIDS
May occur in patients with atopic dermatitis
May be iatrogenic
